Full summary: Kicked off the v2 eval gate: synthetic suite (npm run eval) running in background with LLM judges enabled via the user's zshrc key (commented-out there; passed per-process, never exported or printed). Holdout suite queued next.
Findings: No 1.23-era eval baseline exists: test/eval/results/regression-baseline.json and latest.json both date to 2026-03-02 (plugin 1.1.3 era, synthetic 0.8848 / holdout 0.9951, 100% effective pass rate). The v2 ship-gate comparison is therefore v2-tree vs March baseline + absolute scorer thresholds; a true 1.23 comparison requires checking out the v1.23.0 tag and re-running the suite there.; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is deliberately commented out in ~/.zshrc (likely to avoid clashing with Claude Code auth) — eval judge scorers skip silently without it; future eval runs must inject it per-process the same way.
